projects.title: QR Payment Integration via BCP Bank API
projects.description: Integration with BCP Bank for QR-based payment processing. A Node.js microservice was developed that receives the payment amount and dynamically generates a QR code ready to be scanned from the user's banking app. The project included thorough testing in the sandbox environment provided by the bank before going live in production.

projects.title: Classified Ads Website: AnunciosBo
projects.description: Development of a classified ads platform with full functionality for posting and searching listings. The site is organized into categories, each with tailored fields and filters that streamline navigation and enhance the overall user experience.

projects.title: English Learning Web App: Stories English
projects.description: Personal project. A web application designed to help users learn English through interactive stories. It features a React frontend and a Django REST Framework backend. Currently running as an MVP with 8 interactive stories, blending reading, comprehension, and language practice in a dynamic environment.

projects.title: Barbershop Website: DeibyBarber.com
projects.description: Website initially built with React and later migrated to WordPress so the client could manage it independently through a CMS. The migration preserved the original design and functionality. The React source code is publicly available on GitHub.
